{{TournamentPageStart|twitchid=lec|toclimit=2|text=The '''LEC 2025 Winter Season''' is the first split of the third year of EMEA's unified professional League of Legends league. In Stage 1, ten teams compete in a single round robin group stage, with the top eight advancing to Playoffs, a double elimination bracket.}}
==Overview==
=== Format ===
* Regular Season (Stage 1):
** 10 teams participate
** Single Round Robin
** All matches are best of one
** Top eight teams advance to [[LEC/2025 Season/Winter Playoffs|Playoffs]]
